source.author: verg
source.text: Feror huc, et litore curvo moenia prima loco, fatis ingressus iniquis, Aeneadasque meo nomen de nomine fingo.
source.text_original: Feror huc, et litore curvo / moenia prima loco, fatis ingressus iniquis, / Aeneadasque meo nomen de nomine fingo.
source.text_english: I am carried hither, and here on the curving shore I set down my first walls, having entered under hostile fates, and from my own name I fashion the name Aeneadae for my people.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: heu quibus ingreditur fatis, qui gentibus horror pergit.
reuse.text_original: heu quibus ingreditur fatis, qui gentibus horror / pergit.
reuse.text_english: Alas, under what fates he advances, he who goes forth as a terror to nations.
